Governance Control Tower - Role Pack

JDs for the Gemini Enterprise / ADK delivery pod, AssureAI Governance build phase

Roles in This Pack

Gemini - AssureAI Engineer (2 positions)

Gemini - Integration Specialist (1 position)

Gemini - Governance Engineer (1 position)

Gemini - AI Trust & Compliance Engineer (1 position)

Gemini - AI Engineer, RAG Agents (3 positions - staff augmentation / contract)

The Platform Environment

Shared context for every role below - the platform these positions build, govern, and operate:

Gemini Enterprise - the employee-facing surface: managed chat, enterprise search, agent gallery, and app-scoped experiences serving all of CSGs business functions.

Agent Platform - the build, govern, and operate layer: ADK and agent runtime, agent and tool registry, agent identity, agent security, agent observability.

Custom front-end applications calling Gemini Enterprise via API, with end-user identity propagation.

Integration and data layer - enterprise connectors across Google Workspace and Microsoft 365, BYO and vendor-managed MCP servers, and federated retrieval across function-scoped data stores.

AssureAI - the assurance engine wired into the registry and CI/CD: Pillar 3 (Trustworthiness) evaluators for explainability, bias/red-team, and regulation coverage today, with the other three pillars available as the platforms scope grows.

All five roles report into the pod led by the GCP AI Architect and are accountable, in different ways, for the architecture checklist mapped to AssureAIs Trustworthiness metrics.

What You;ll Do

Design and build full-stack web applications end to end front-end UI, back-end services, APIs, and datalayer
Build and consume well-structured REST (and where relevant GraphQL) APIs, with clean, documentedcontracts
Integrate LLM / AI capabilities into applications calling model provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini,or Azure OpenAI), wiring up retrieval or RAG features, and handling streaming responses, prompts, andstructured outputs
Design and work with relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) schemadesign, queries, and performance
Own deployment: containerize with Docker and ship through Git-based CI/CD pipelines to cloudinfrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Write maintainable, tested code and participate in code reviews
Collaborate with product, design, and other engineers, and communicate progress and tradeoffs clearly tonon-technical stakeholders
Take prototypes to production quickly and reliably within the contract window

Principle Developer - ML/Prompt Engineer
Technologies: Amazon Bedrock, RAG Models, Java, Python, C or C++, AWS Lambda,


Responsibilities:
Responsible for developing, deploying, and maintaining a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) model in Amazon Bedrock, our cloud-based platform for building and scaling generative AI applications.
Design and implement a RAG model that can generate natural language responses, commands, and actions based on user queries and context, using the Anthropic Claude model as the backbone.
Integrate the RAG model with Amazon Bedrock, our platform that offers a choice of high-performing foundation models from leading AI companies and Amazon via a single API, along with a broad set of capabilities to build generative AI applications with security, privacy, and responsible AI.
Optimize the RAG model for performance, scalability, and reliability, using best practices and robust engineering methodologies.
Design, test, and optimize prompts to improve performance, accuracy, and alignment of large language models across diverse use cases.
Develop and maintain reusable prompt templates, chains, and libraries to support scalable and consistent GenAI applications.

Skills/Qualifications:
Experience in programming with at least one software language, such as Java, Python, or C/C++.
Experience in working with generative AI tools, models, and frameworks, such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Jupyter.
Experience in working with RAG models or similar architectures, such as RAG, Ragna, or Pinecone.
Experience in working with Amazon Bedrock or similar platforms, such as AWS Lambda, Amazon SageMaker, or Amazon Comprehend.
Ability to design, iterate, and optimize prompts for various LLM use cases (e.g., summarization, classification, translation, Q&A, and agent workflows).
Deep understanding of prompt engineering techniques (zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought, etc.) and their effect on model behavior.
Familiarity with prompt evaluation strategies, including manual review, automatic metrics, and A/B testing frameworks.
Experience building prompt libraries, reusable templates, and structured prompt workflows for scalable GenAI applications.
Ability to debug and refine prompts to improve accuracy, safety, and alignment with business objectives.
Awareness of prompt injection risks and experience implementing mitigation strategies.
Familiarity with prompt tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), and prompt chaining methods.
Familiarity with continuous deployment and DevOps tools preferred. Experience with Git preferred
Experience working in agile/scrum environments
Successful track record interfacing and communicating effectively across cross-functional teams.
Good communication, analytical and presentation skills, problem-solving skills and learning attitude

We are looking for an AI Product Data Scientist with strong expertise in Agentic AI systems and product ecosystem architecture . The ideal candidate will bridge AI research, data science, and product engineering to design, build, and scale intelligent autonomous systems across enterprise products.

Responsibilities
Design and develop agentic AI systems (multi-agent workflows, autonomous decision systems, orchestration frameworks).
Build AI-driven product features across end-to-end product ecosystems (APIs, services, data platforms, automation pipelines).
Work closely with product managers, engineering teams, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into AI solutions.

Ensure AI systems are scalable, reliable, explainable, and production-ready.
Drive experimentation, model evaluation, and continuous improvement in AI products.

Strong experience in Data Science, ML, and AI product development.

Experience with LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, etc.).
Solid programming skills in Python (FastAPI, ML libraries, data pipelines).
Experience designing AI product ecosystems (microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, cloud-native architectures).
Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and MLOps pipelines.
Strong understanding of product metrics, experimentation, and AI-driven product strategy.

We are hiring a Gen AI Data Scientist with strong expertise in Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models (LLMs). The candidate will work on developing AI-powered intelligent solutions, enterprise GenAI applications, and advanced analytics use cases.

Develop LLM-based applications using RAG architecture.
Work on prompt engineering, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
Fine-tune and optimize AI models for business use cases.
Develop scalable AI solutions using Python and cloud platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver AI-driven products.

Ensure model performance, scalability, and responsible AI practices.

3+ years of experience in Artificial Intelligence Engineering or a related field.

Knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and ability to apply them in real-world scenarios.
Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python and familiarity with SQL.

Design, develop, test, and deploy AI-powered solutions using AIMl to improve business processes and customer experiences.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas for improvement and implement data-driven insights from machine learning models.
Develop and maintain complex algorithms, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance of AI systems.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends in AI technology and recommend innovative solutions to drive business growth.

6.11-16 years of experience in IT Services & Consulting as an Artificial Intelligence Engineer or related field.
Strong proficiency in Python programming language with expertise in developing AI applications using various libraries such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Experience working on large datasets to extract valuable insights through statistical analysis or machine learning techniques.
